changelog: Added full PHP 8.4 and PHP 8.5 runtime and isolated pool support
Updated domain creation and switcher UI with PHP 8.4 and PHP 8.5 options
Fixed Database Manager SQL export to export both schema and full data rows
Added batched chunked INSERT statements in SQL export to prevent packet overflow
Enhanced installer with --php and --php-version CLI flags and resilient extension packages
Removed legacy PHP 8.5 package purging routine during webmail setup
